Remark
[Compatibility conditions] ↗ thm:hyperbolic-higher-regularity ↗ thm:mappings-into-better-spaces 1. ch7:7.2.3-rem-4\group Regularity

The time traces obey \[ f(0)\in H^{m-1}(U),\quad f'(0)\in H^{m-2}(U),\quad \ldots ,\quad f^{(m-2)}(0)\in H^1(U), \tag {65} \] and the recursively defined data satisfy \[ g_0\in H^{m+1}(U),\ h_1\in H^m(U),\ g_2\in H^{m-1}(U),\ h_3\in H^{m-2}(U),\ldots . \tag {66} \] Compatibility requires each listed datum to have zero trace on $\partial U$.
